facts.fact: Togo's Ministry of Justice said on 2023-12-06 that its 2022 sector statistical yearbook, validated on 2023-12-04 at a UNDP-financed workshop, is now available, with data collected from courts, prisons and maisons de justice.
facts.system: Annuaire statistique 2022 du secteur de la justice

facts.fact: The ministry says the 2022 justice yearbook rests on field collection of data from judicial services, courts, penitentiary establishments and maisons de justice, compiled by its statistics unit.
facts.system: Annuaire statistique 2022 du secteur de la justice

facts.fact: The ministry says the 2022 justice yearbook continues earlier editions and is accompanied by an analysis of key indicators.
